estimator_change: Transport the remembered direction and the v4 anchor from the previous camera coordinates into current camera coordinates using the supplied camera-to-world rotations. Keep the same 5-degree cone, low-pass, and front/lateral estimation rules.
capture: Use full, truth control, tool_pose, default verified scene, shadow frame dump, no pose/depth perturbation during capture, and new empty output directories. Before scoring, verify that the post-home ECM target equals the registered yaw/pitch (1e-6 degree numerical equality), the physical camera rotation differs from home, and every sheet frame was captured at the registered target. Require complete, contiguous captures with at least one pre-sheet and one sheet frame.
evaluation: Use all original gates, thresholds, seeds, development datasets and degradations unchanged. Apply the original seven per-view gates to each replacement dataset. The two other v3 holdouts are reused and disclosed as such; they are not pristine. Fail aggregate checks with missing datasets, and zero-count checks with no relevant samples. Record metadata and frame hashes and the amendment in new reports.
acceptance: The v3 acceptance does not transfer. Report all failures and require a new explicit user decision before using this evaluation as acceptance of a closed loop. Do not inspect or tune on the new holdouts before the estimator is frozen.
